name: AcImportXMLOption
description: Specifies the action to take when using the Application.ImportXML method (Access) method to import data from an XML file.

constants.name: acStructureOnly
constants.description: Creates a new table based on the structure of the specified XML file.

constants.name: acStructureAndData
constants.description: Imports the data into a new table based on the structure of the specified XML file.

constants.name: acAppendData
constants.description: Imports the data into an existing table.
